overview.headline: Radioactive half-life definition, time range and alternate names

keyPoints.point: Half-life is the time for half of the atoms of a particular radioactive substance to disintegrate into another nuclear form
keyPoints.quote: The time in which one half of the atoms of a particular radioactive substance disintegrate into another nuclear form.

keyPoints.point: Measured half-lives vary from millionths of a second to billions of years
keyPoints.quote: Measured half-lives vary from millionths of a second to billions of years.

keyPoints.point: Also called physical or radiological half-life as an alternate designation
keyPoints.quote: Also called physical or radiological half-life.
